table.retrieve:
SELECT
	H.GLVochCode,
	H.Date,
	H.PostDate,
	D.AccCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	D.Remarks,
	Amount = CASE 
			WHEN D.Debit > 0 THEN D.Debit
			WHEN D.Credit > 0 THEN D.Credit
			ELSE 0 END,
	/*detail_accountname=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=D.acccode),*/
	U.UserName,
	D.ChkNo,
	H.VoucherCode,
	VoucherCategory = (SELECT V.Name FROM vochercategory V WHERE V.VochCatCode = H.Vochcatcode),
	InvoiceCode=D.InvoiceCode,
	InvoiceBased=(SELECT V.InvoiceBased FROM vochercategory V WHERE V.VochCatCode = H.Vochcatcode)
FROM
	GLHeader H, GLDetail D, Accounts A, Users U
WHERE
	H.VochCatCode = :ai_VochCatCode AND
	H.Date >= :ar_StartDate AND
	H.Date <= :ar_EndDate AND
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND
	H.AccCode <> D.AccCode AND
	H.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	H.SalesManCode = U.UserCode
